description: This file defines a database migration class for version 4.4.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It creates multiple tables related to a 'Buzz' social feature, adds foreign keys, indexes, inserts configuration settings, and permissions related to this feature.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class extending AbstractMigration, responsible for defining database schema updates, seed data, and permissions for the 'Buzz' feature in OrangeHRM version 4.4.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration: creates tables, adds foreign keys and indexes, inserts configuration data, permissions, and menu items related to the 'Buzz' feature.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.4' indicating the migration version.

methods.name: insertConfig
methods.description: Helper method to insert key-value pairs into the configuration table.
